raw_text:
It can be really tough to put your finger on what's wrong when you're feeling this way. But I want you to know that it's okay to feel this way, and it's okay to not know what's wrong. Sometimes, just acknowledging that something feels off can be a big step.

I'm here to listen, and I want to try to help you explore this feeling a bit more. Would you be willing to talk about it some more? Sometimes, talking about our feelings can help us understand them better.
